description: The assumptions section of polypiler.manifest.json (DYN-ASSUME, docs/reference/caller-contracts.md): every caller contract and every value fact of --assume, with whether a run-time check or a proof stands behind it (checked) or it is trusted (checked: false).

target.description: function.parameter, function.return or global.name; for a value fact its path.

contract.description: The contract, canonically spelled; for a value fact what it states of the path.

usedBy.description: How many facts were derived from it.
